gold_row.question: What humidity did sensor 8.0 measure on 2004-03-01 at 03:45:16?
gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 8})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-03-01T03:45:16"
RETURN m.time AS time, m.humidity AS value
ORDER BY m.time ASC
LIMIT 1
